cohort: The study included 393 postpartum mothers from Rajshahi Division, Bangladesh.
finding: The study found a high prevalence of caesarean section deliveries in the Rajshahi Division of Bangladesh, with factors such as older maternal age, higher maternal education, lower paternal education, and lower family income associated with higher CS rates.
mod_finding: Older maternal age (>= 30 years), higher maternal education, lower paternal education, employment in the service sector, non-Muslim religion, lower family income, and residence in Naogaon district were significantly associated with higher rates of caesarean section delivery.
